fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (NASDAQ: WMT) is a major retailer with market capitalization around $1 trillion and 10.9 million locations globally, with stock up 73.5% in 2024 but currently overvalued at P/E of 38x (5-year average 27x).
fields.summary_ko.1: From current levels of approximately $126 per share, reaching $200 within five years would generate roughly 60% returns (10% annualized), though higher returns may be achievable following price correction; holding is recommended pending better entry.
